title: Ship Sizes
description: Required design choice. Determines profile on the waves and how many crew and passengers fit comfortably.

options.name: Nano
options.description: Suited for a single sailor and maybe a passenger or two.

options.name: Small
options.description: Suited for 2-4 people, cramped but serviceable for double that. Ideal for a first ship.

options.name: Standard
options.description: Comfortable for 5-10 people, the majority of ships on the Wildsea are this size.

options.name: Large
options.description: Can house 10-20 crew with room to spare, but harder to dock and go unnoticed.
